verdict.rationale: Mistral documents a model-lifecycle page stating that each Serverless API model moves through defined stages from release to retirement. The page says to use these stages to plan migrations before a model is retired, and it separately describes experimental Labs models. The evidence does not show a specific advance-notice period or concrete migration guidance, so only part of the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a stated advance-notice window before retirement, explicit migration guidance or replacement-model mapping, and independent or hands-on corroboration that deprecations follow the policy.
